title: Hill & Ridge Community Market, September 2026 (Restart)
summary: First market of the 2026–2027 season restart at Red Hill Recreation Reserve. Monthly artisan market celebrating local food, wine, produce, crafts and community. Fresh local products; food stalls; winemaker presence and artisan wares.
nearbyAttractions: Stonier Wines; Polperro; Foxeys Hangout; Arthur's Seat Eagle
suggestedItineraryPairing: Pair with a winery lunch at one of the Red Hill estates
editorVerdict: Hill & Ridge is the quieter sibling to Red Hill Market: same ridge, fewer crowds, more winemakers in attendance.
editorNote:
September 5 marks the 2026-27 season kick-off for Hill & Ridge at Red Hill Recreation Reserve. First Saturday of the month, September through May, run by the Red Hill Agricultural Society. Local food, wine, produce, crafts, and the genuinely useful thing: winemakers from the surrounding estates often turn up themselves.

The move: pair it with a winery lunch at Stonier, Polperro or Foxeys Hangout. It runs rain or shine, but the ridge gets cold and wet in early spring, so dress for it. If the Red Hill Show is on the same weekend (check March), expect traffic chaos.
